stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has officially rejected President Donald Trump's 15-point plan aimed at disarming Hamas and facilitating an Israeli withdrawal from Gaza. Netanyahu emphasized that Israel will not withdraw its military forces until Hamas is fully disarmed.

stories.title: Over 20,000 Evacuated as Wildfires Rage in British Columbia
stories.summary: A fast-moving wildfire in British Columbia has prompted the evacuation of over 20,000 residents as the province declared a state of emergency. The Bald Range wildfire has spread rapidly, fueled by strong winds and dry conditions, with more than 100 wildfires currently burning across the region. Officials report that nearly half of these fires are out of control, posing significant challenges for firefighting efforts.

stories.title: Escalating Attacks Leave Casualties in Ukraine and Russia Amid New Military Deals
stories.summary: Recent drone and missile strikes have resulted in multiple casualties in both Ukraine and Russia. In Ukraine, at least four people, including a child, were killed in attacks on Kyiv and surrounding regions. Concurrently, Ukraine has reportedly finalized a deal to purchase ATACMS missile systems from Turkey to bolster its defense capabilities. On the Russian side, drone attacks have led to fatalities in Belgorod, with reports indicating that five people were killed.

stories.title: FIFA Defends President Infantino Against Allegations and Criticism
stories.summary: FIFA has issued a strong defense of its president, Gianni Infantino, condemning what it describes as a 'concerted and ongoing effort' to undermine him and the organization. This response comes amid increasing pressure on Infantino, including allegations related to his conduct during his tenure at UEFA and the collapse of plans to sell a stake in the World Cup. FIFA's criticism also addresses claims regarding a severance payment to an alleged mistress of Infantino.

stories.title: Japan Commemorates 81st Anniversary of Nagasaki Atomic Bombing
stories.summary: On the 81st anniversary of the atomic bombing of Nagasaki, Mayor Shiro Suzuki condemned the increasing global support for nuclear deterrence, asserting that 'humanity and nuclear weapons cannot coexist.' He labeled nuclear weapons as 'absolute evil' and urged the Japanese government to uphold its non-nuclear principles established after World War II.

stories.title: Death Toll Rises to Nine in Thailand School Shooting as 12-Year-Old Girl Dies
stories.summary: A 12-year-old girl has died from critical injuries sustained during a school shooting in Nonthaburi province, Thailand, raising the death toll to at least nine. The shooting, which occurred on Friday, involved a 14-year-old assailant who also reportedly killed his grandparents before opening fire at Debsirin Nonthaburi School. The shooter is believed to have taken his own life following the attack.

stories.title: Senate Confirms Todd Blanche as Attorney General Amid Controversy
stories.summary: The Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as the new Attorney General with a narrow vote of 50-49 early Saturday morning. The confirmation followed a contentious process, with concerns raised about Blanche's ability to maintain independence from President Trump's influence over the Justice Department. Democrats criticized Blanche, labeling him an enabler of Trump's alleged corruption.

stories.title: Spain Implements Temporary Border Checks for Italian Travelers Amid Migrant Dispute
stories.summary: Spain has introduced temporary border checks for travelers arriving from Italy, effective from midnight on Saturday. This action follows Italy's recent implementation of similar measures in response to a significant influx of migrants from Morocco into Spain's Ceuta enclave, where approximately 78,000 migrants have crossed. The situation has escalated tensions between the two EU nations over migration policies.
